note: Native non-Git adapter (prototype). Input is the documented `fossil timeline -F` placeholder format (%H|%a|%d|%b|%p|%t|%c). A Fossil check-in artifact id is a SHA-1/SHA-256 hash and is never converted to a Git hash; the author login is raw evidence, not an account; phase tokens and tags are counts, not semantics. Parsing is fixture-driven in the local gate because fossil is not installed there.
